title: The Pain Axis: LLMs Represent Self-Directed Harm and Act to Relieve It
reasoning: The paper investigates whether Large Language Models possess internal representations analogous to pain or suffering, and whether manipulating these representations drives self-protective or relief-seeking behavior. While it explores the profound ethical implications of AI welfare and uses 'moral injury' as one category of psychological pain, the research does not benchmark or evaluate the models' moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religious knowledge.
